caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear vessel resembling a bottle or decanter, centrally placed against a plain, light-colored background. The vessel is rendered in shades of grayish-blue, white, and subtle brownish shadows, giving it a glass-like appearance with apparent reflections and highlights. Its body is twisted in a spiral pattern, with three main lobes creating a swirling effect. Around the upper neck of the vessel, there is a band of raised spherical ornaments. The neck is cylindrical, slightly flaring at the rim, and has a circular flat top. The base is broad and faceted, matching the width of the twisted body. The background is unadorned, with faint discoloration near the upper corners of the paper. There are no other objects or patterns present in the composition.
title: Candlestick
